'''Gregg Garris''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[March 2001 Knoxville tournament]] on 4 March 2001 with Spies and Mains (starting Massassi War Room), according to Joseph Hennessey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1844">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-4-mar-2001-knoxville-gaming-bureau-kgbd1844/ 4-mar-2001-knoxville-gaming-bureau-kgb], DeckTech (Joseph "bluehead" Hennessey, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-4-mar-2001-knoxville-gaming-bureau-kgbd1844/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
